column2: Retain Mattathias, John, Simeon, Joarib priestly ancestry, Jerusalem and settlement in Modein. The from-Jerusalem phrase remains contextual origin rather than proof of an expressly narrated departure.
Retain five sons and John called Gaddi as the first entry. The roster continues across three more stored units.
Retain Simon called Thassi, distinct from the ancestor Simeon in verse 1. Similar name forms do not establish the same bearer.
Retain Judas called Maccabeus. No explanatory etymology is inserted into the name.
Retain Eleazar/Avaran and Jonathan/Apphous as the final two sons. Both bynames and the five-person total remain.
Retain sight of blasphemies happening in Judah and Jerusalem. His response begins in the next unit without a supplied new speaker.

Retain the lament's birth question, twice ruin, sitting there, city surrendered to enemies and sanctuary to foreigners. Five proposed display lines preserve the successive parallel clauses without changing wording.
Retain her temple compared to a man without honor. Do not silently replace the human simile with a generalized desecrated building description.

Retain captive glorious vessels, slain little children in squares and young men by enemy sword. Preserve the inherited three-line display; the final clause carries the preceding death verb implicitly.
Retain the rhetorical question about any nation failing to acquire royal places and spoils. Two proposed lines distinguish the two predicates; her is supplied from the personified city.
column3: Royal places remains a provisional rendering of the palace/royal-property noun.

column2: Retain loss of all adornment and the free woman becoming a slave. Preserve the inherited two-line display and feminine city personification.
Retain behold, our holy places/beauty/glory laid waste and nations profaning them. Two proposed lines separate devastation and profanation.
column3: Holy places is a contextual rendering of the neuter holy things, not a proven limitation to buildings.

column2: Retain the question about continuing to live, closing the lament. No explanatory answer is added.
Retain Mattathias and sons tearing garments, wearing sackcloth and intense mourning. The physical acts remain in their narrated sequence.
Retain royal officials compelling apostasy, arrival in Modein and sacrificial purpose. Make the people sacrifice supplies the implied coercive target from context.
column3: The unexpressed subject of the purpose clause is not independently explicit; the English causal expansion remains provisional.

column2: Retain many Israelites approaching them and Mattathias/sons gathering. Gathering is not replaced with a direct refusal before the speech begins.
Retain ruler, honored and great, this city and support from sons/brothers. These are the officials' words of persuasion, not a newly certified office title.

Retain priority in compliance, the alleged examples, twice you and sons, royal Friends and silver/gold/gifts. Friends is treated as a provisional court designation without inventing a rank description.
Retain conditional all nations in the king's realm, obedience, each abandoning ancestral worship and their completed choice of commands. The present/past distinction is not regularized.
Retain Mattathias, sons and brothers walking in their fathers' covenant. The family-inclusive commitment answers the preceding conditional.
Retain Far be it as the idiomatic repudiation of abandoning law and ordinances. No expressly named divine speaker or invocation is added.
Retain refusal to hear the king by departing from worship right or left. Both directions and the worship object remain.
Retain a Jewish man approaching publicly after the speech, sacrifice on Modein's pagan altar and conformity to the decree. The man remains unnamed.
Retain zeal, trembling inward parts, anger according to judgment, running and slaughter on the altar. Inward parts renders the kidney image more broadly, without omitting the bodily response.
column3: The anatomical idiom and according to judgment remain specialist questions; the narrative's rationale is not recast as present-day approval of violence.

column2: Retain the additional killing of the royal coercing officer at that time and destruction of the altar. This is a second victim distinct from the sacrificing man.
Retain zeal for law and the comparison with Phinehas toward Zimri son of Salom. No different paternal form is substituted from Numbers.
Retain the loud city call to everyone zealous for law and upholding covenant to follow. The two qualifications remain conjunctive.
Retain flight of father and sons into mountains and all city possessions left. No unexpressed companions or supplies are added.
Retain many seeking righteousness and judgment going down to wilderness settlement. Judgment is not simply deleted as redundant with righteousness.
Retain sons, wives and livestock and severe evils as cause. With carries forward the travelers of verse 29 without requiring a new journey verb.
Retain report to royal men and Jerusalem/City-of-David forces about command-rejecters in wilderness hiding places. The report is not converted into direct speech without markers.
Retain pursuit, overtaking, encampment and battle preparation on Sabbath. No single summary attack verb replaces the sequence.
Retain the abrupt Enough of this, demand to come out and comply, and promised life. The elliptical opening remains a provisional idiomatic rendering.
Retain refusal both to emerge and to follow the decree by profaning Sabbath. The opponents' promised survival does not erase the refusal.
Retain the hurried attack and pronoun shift back to the attackers. Their names are not supplied where the source leaves them implicit.
Retain the defenders' nonresponse, no stone thrown and no blocking of hiding places. The three omitted defensive acts are preserved.

Retain voluntary collective death in integrity and heaven/earth witnessing that destruction occurs without judgment. Integrity is a provisional rendering of singleness/simplicity; without judgment is not made a formal trial narrative.
Retain Sabbath attack, men/wives/children/livestock dying and approximately 1,000 human lives. The human total does not include a claimed livestock count.
column3: The extent/approximation force of up to remains open; about preserves an approximate rather than exact tally.

column2: Retain Mattathias and friends learning and greatly mourning. The narrative distinguishes their response from the victims' prior decision.
Retain neighbor-to-neighbor reasoning, the conditional example of brothers, lives/ordinances and imminent destruction. The proposed policy arises within their speech.

Retain that day's decision to fight anyone attacking on Sabbath and emphatic avoidance of all dying like the hidden brothers. It addresses attack-defense, not an unexpressed universal authorization of warfare.
Retain the Hasidean company, strong Israelite fighters and everyone volunteering for the law. No additional later sect identity is asserted.
Retain all refugees from evils joining and becoming support. The breadth of all is preserved within the narrative's described group.
Retain army formation, angry striking of sinners/lawless men and the remainder fleeing to nations for safety. The moral labels remain attributed to the narrative.
Retain Mattathias/friends' circuit and demolition of pagan altars. The selected altar terminology remains consistent with the context at 1:47.
Retain forcible circumcision of all uncircumcised boys found within Israel. The expressed force is not softened into voluntary observance.
Retain pursuit of sons of arrogance and the work's success in their hands. The image is not replaced with a new ethnic or political identification.
Retain taking hold of the law from nations/kings and denying the sinner a horn. Do not substitute an assured technical political power for the image.
column3: The taking-hold verb and horn expression remain provisional lexical questions.

column2: Retain approaching death, strengthened arrogance/rebuke and a time of overthrow/furious wrath. The nominal time phrase is not made a new dated event.
column3: Rebuke and the coordination of the four crisis expressions need further spoken-language review.

column2: Retain children, zeal for law and giving lives for the fathers' covenant. Lives represents souls in the life-sacrifice context, not an added immortality claim.
Retain remembering ancestral deeds by generations and imperative receiving glory and an enduring name. The reward wording is not silently converted into an unqualified future statement.
Retain Abraham found faithful in testing and reckoning as righteousness. The English repeats the question frame for readability without adding a new object to the reckoning.
Retain Joseph's distress, keeping the singular command and lordship over Egypt. Lord remains a human office title here.
Retain Phinehas our father, emphatic zeal and a covenant of everlasting priesthood. The ancestral title is not restricted to immediate parenthood.
Retain Joshua fulfilling the word and becoming judge in Israel. Judge is not changed to a different leadership title.
Retain Caleb's testimony in assembly and inheritance of land. The specific land is not named in this summary.
Retain David's mercy and inherited royal throne forever. Lowercase his leaves the nearest human referent without silently identifying the mercy as God's.
column3: The possessive antecedent and mercy's contextual sense remain open.

column2: Retain Elijah's zeal for law and passive taking into heaven. No agent or transport mechanism is added.
Retain Hananiah/Azariah/Mishael, trust and rescue from flame. No object of trust or Babylonian alternative names are inserted.
Retain Daniel's integrity and rescue from the mouth of lions. Mouth is singular with plural lions; no numerical reconstruction is supplied.

Propose will not grow weak for will not fail, preserving the selected weakening verb and its distinction from utter failure. Retain generation-by-generation reflection and hope in Him; two proposed display lines separate the exhortation and assurance. The close draft keeps fail.
column3: Him is contextually God but is not named within this clause; the scope of weakness in the assurance remains open.

column2: Retain refusal to fear the sinful man's words and his glory becoming dung and worms. Two proposed display lines preserve warning and reason; no softened decay euphemism is introduced.
Retain today exalted, tomorrow not found, past return to his dust and future perishing thought. Four proposed lines expose the selected tense sequence rather than harmonizing it.
column3: The perfective/past return within future surrounding clauses and thought versus plan remain provisional.

column2: Retain children, courage, strength in law and being glorified through it. The law is the contextual pronoun referent rather than a newly named person.
Retain behold, Simon the brother, known counsel, enduring command to listen and his future father-role. The relational title is not a claim of literal paternity.
Retain Judas Maccabeus's youthful strength, military command and battle of peoples. The plural peoples is not silently changed to a singular possessive our people.
column3: Battle of peoples remains a provisional genitive expression requiring contextual review.

column2: Retain bringing law-doers to them and exacting vengeance for their people. The future bring is rendered as an exhortation within the command sequence, not as an independent prediction.
Retain repayment to the nations and attention to the law's command. What is due represents the repayment idiom without specifying an unexpressed penalty.
Retain blessing the sons and being gathered to the fathers. The explicit death date follows rather than being inserted here.
Retain year 146, burial in ancestral tombs at Modein and all Israel's great lament. No modern calendar conversion or extra lifespan is supplied.
